name: AuxPair.smul_chosenGLRep_eq
summary: With S = diag(s, 1) at M and 1 at Q, the element liftResidue(S)^(-1) k lies in the level of O (its reductions S^(-1) tau fix the incl-columns at M and lie in the parabolic at Q, by the block conditions), so it acts on y by the level character; applying pi(liftResidue(S)) gives chosenGLRep(s) y times the character values.

steps.claim: Combine the scalar factors (smul_smul) and compare pi(k) y with chosenGLRep applied to y, using a lift of S below.
steps.lean:
π k y := set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in (smul_smul ..).trans (by
  let S := firstBlockHom _ O.incl (s <| .inl ·)
  have := by simpa [entrywise] using (H <| .inr ·)
  have T j : S (.inr j) = 1 := rfl
  simpa [*, MulChar.inv_apply_eq_inv', submatrix, MulChar.apply_eq_zero_iff] using! congr(π
    (liftResidue S) $(levelSpace_levelOf_apply y.2 ((liftResidue S)⁻¹ * k) ⟨S⁻¹ * τ,
    Sum.rec (by simpa [↓mem_stabilizer_col_iff, S, firstBlockHom, -inclMatrix,
    inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible] using (H <| .inl ·)) (by simp +contextual
    [mem_rangeParabolic_iff, *, eq_comm])⟩ (by simp [reduceFamily_liftResidue, e]))).symm)

steps.claim: Let S = firstBlockHom(O, incl(O))((s_j) at M): diag(s_j, 1) at the chosen places and 1 at the twist places.
At the twist places the block condition, read entrywise, says that tau_j^T maps the incl-columns into their span through s_j^T.
S is 1 at every twist place.
steps.lean: have T j : S (.inr j) = 1 := rfl

steps.claim: liftResidue(S)^(-1) k lies in levelGroup(O): its reductions S^(-1) tau fix the incl-basis vectors at the chosen places (block condition at M) and lie in the parabolic at the twist places (block condition at Q). Hence pi(liftResidue(S)^(-1) k) y = levelChar(O)(liftResidue(S)^(-1) k) y; applying pi(liftResidue(S)) and evaluating the level character on S^(-1) tau gives pi(k) y = (prod_j psi_j(det s_j))^(-1) chosenGLRep(O, pi)(s at M) y.
steps.lean:
simpa [*, MulChar.inv_apply_eq_inv', submatrix, MulChar.apply_eq_zero_iff] using! congr(π
    (liftResidue S) $(levelSpace_levelOf_apply y.2 ((liftResidue S)⁻¹ * k) ⟨S⁻¹ * τ,
    Sum.rec (by simpa [↓mem_stabilizer_col_iff, S, firstBlockHom, -inclMatrix,
    inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible] using (H <| .inl ·)) (by simp +contextual
    [mem_rangeParabolic_iff, *, eq_comm])⟩ (by simp [reduceFamily_liftResidue, e]))).symm)
